name: Army Ant Swarm

items.name: Cling
items.text:
Trigger A creature leaves the swarm's space

---

Effect The swarm takes 1d6 untyped damage as ants cling to the creature and continue biting, dealing 3d6 persistent,piercing damage. High winds or immersion in water reduces the DC of the flat check to end this persistent damage to 5. Any area damage dealt to the creature destroys these clinging ants.

items.name: Swarming Bites
items.text:
Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 3d6 piercing damage (DC 21 basic Fortitude save save). A creature that fails its save against Swarming Bites becomes Clumsy 1 for 1 round. If the creature attempts a concentrate or manipulate action while affected, it must succeed at a DC 5 Flat check or the action is lost; roll the check after spending the action, but before any effects are applied.

Effect: Swarming Bites

text:
An army ant swarm is a terrifying carpet of stinging insects that devours all in its path.

---

Ants are industrious insects that aid the natural processes of decay and renewal.
